independent_acceptance.conclusion: Both numbered Minor findings survive independent focused verification. The quotient dimension has +n, and the locally algebraic part contains a genuine nonsplit selfextension; the corrected dimension argument and the weaker socle statement recover the actual conclusions used. No counterexample to the main construction or reconstruction theorem has been established.

problem_checks.source: PDF p19 Corollary 2.14; pp15?18 preceding deformation dimensions
problem_checks.independent_reasoning: With d=[K:Qp], c=n(n-1)/2 and b_L=sum_i n_i(n_i+1)/2, subtracting the stated kernel dimension from the parabolic deformation dimension gives (1+d dim P)-(1+dc-n)=d b_L+n. The target is the same sum of block dimensions. K=Q5, n=2, P=B, crystalline eigenvalues 1 and 2, regular weights 1>0 and filtration line (1,1) satisfy generic ratios and both noncritical refinements; ?taleness is not a hypothesis here. The actual two dimensions are 4, whereas the printed middle expression is 0.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_repair: The minus sign is visible in the source image, so not OCR. The preceding formulas already support +n. The established surjection plus the corrected equal dimensions gives the same isomorphism. A local numerical error is confirmed; failure of Corollary 2.14 is not.

problem_checks.independent_reasoning: For A=pi_alg, V=A tensor E[epsilon]/epsilon^2 with action multiplied by 1+epsilon v_K(det g) is locally algebraic because the added character is smooth. A central uniformizer matrix acts with nonzero Jordan coefficient n in characteristic zero, hence the extension is nonsplit. Hom(A,B_w/A)=0 preserves its class under pushout; the universal extension in Lemma 3.35 and the embedding in Lemma 4.3 place it in the actual tilde-pi before Theorem 4.5 is used. Thus tilde-pi^lalg cannot equal A.
problem_checks.counterevidence_and_repair: Lemma 4.2(2) only gives Hom dimension one and does not exclude this selfextension. Combining that multiplicity with the preceding exclusion of other simple constituents proves soc(tilde-pi)=A, which is the needed conclusion. Main compatibility conclusions are not refuted.
